items.title: Ethereum Foundation warns some tools may break with Glamsterdam upgrade
items.summary: Developers have been urged to test on Plataberget before Glamsterdam’s new gas model reaches Ethereum’s other testnets and mainnet.

items.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade has 66 proposals, including a major privacy fix
items.summary: Developers are narrowing the list for the Hegotá upgrade, including a package to change how wallets approve and pay for transactions, giving developers of privacy apps more of the tools they need inside Ethereum itself.

items.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler’s Digest
items.summary: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.

items.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
items.summary: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

items.title: Ethereum devs to narrow 66 proposals tied to Hegotá upgrade
items.summary: The Hegotá upgrade aims to introduce more native privacy for Ethereum applications.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing for AI security push
items.summary: Payward will use Anthropic’s cybersecurity model to hunt vulnerabilities and share open-source findings.

items.title: Bitpanda fined 70,000 euros in Austria’s first published MiCA enforcement case
items.summary: The fine stems from Bitpanda failing to submit a mandatory white paper 20 days before publication and omitting required disclosures in marketing materials.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises above $64,000 as big AI compute deals continue to roll in
items.summary: Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has ground to a near halt as the 60-day truce lapses with no deal, reviving the oil-price risk that has capped crypto all summer. ETF flows, meanwhile, are quietly turning.

items.title: The bitcoin price level where leveraged bulls could get whacked
items.summary: Bulls are stacking longs, liquidity is thinning and one key level could trigger large liquidations.

items.title: XRP sinks below $1 for first time since 2024 as Korean bank adopts Ripple Payments
items.summary: Jeonbuk Bank will use Ripple’s 24/7 cross-border payment service for business remittances, but it is unknown whether the flows will use XRP or Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin.

items.title: Monad, an Ethereum rival, offered early investors up to $60 million to cash out. Almost all said no
items.summary: The program came three months before investor unlocks begin, with MON trading below its public-sale price and most of the token supply still outside circulation.

items.title: Bitcoin climbs above $64,000 while most majors slip
items.summary: Miners have cut their computing power by a fifth over three quarters to make room for AI, and Venice's token jumped 10% after the company said it crossed $100 million in annualised revenue.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank taps Ripple for cross-border payments
items.summary: Ripple is bringing its cross-border payments platform to Jeonbuk Bank, but key details including its launch status and settlement asset remain undisclosed.

items.title: Alleged $165M crypto Ponzi mastermind faces US charges after Fiji deportation
items.summary: Prosecutors allege Edward Zimbardi collected crypto from thousands of investors, lost over $34 million on currency trades and spent at least $10 million personally.

items.title: ‘Fabricated rumors’ about BitMart founder, Binance bStocks dominate: Asia Express
items.summary: Binance’s bStocks are the second largest tokenized stock issuer just two months after launch, and BitMart’s internal feud erupts into the spotlight ahead of its closure

items.title: Saylor says share buyback isn’t priority as Strategy builds $4.8 billion cash reserve
items.summary: Strategy is prioritizing STRC, cash reserves, and its credit business over stock buybacks, Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said Monday.

items.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
items.summary: Sheldon Lee said a Chinese-language X account making the claims was hacked. Users want wallets, assets and liabilities disclosed.

items.title: Compound bets $52 million, new leadership team in switch to institutional focus
items.summary: The protocol pioneered decentralized finance lending, but assets locked have tumbled from a peak five years ago. Now it's looking to attract institutions after retail traders lost interest.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
items.summary: The Treasury proposal would establish some of the core definitions and jurisdictions in the law Congress completed last year.
